dataList.name: Out-of-style Rouge Clothing
dataList.desc:
When allies heal HP through Base Attack Skills' Skill or Coin effects, heal +50% HP (3 times per turn; rounded down)

[Haute Couture::Boutique du Rouge Ishmael Exclusive Effect]
If Haute Couture::The Crimson God of Le Rouge Sinclair is with this unit on the field, gain 1 [RougeIshmaelCocoon] at Turn Start and enter [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state (once per Encounter)
- If "In this Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, nullify that damage; then, immediately gain 2 [RougeIshmaelCocoon] and enter the [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state (once per Encounter)" from the Passive "Into the <noparse>Changing Room</noparse>…" activated, the exclusive effect does not activate
- When the exclusive effect activates, the effect "In this Encounter, when this unit takes damage that brings its HP down to 0, nullify that damage; then, immediately gain 2 [RougeIshmaelCocoon] and enter the [RougeIshmaelCocoon] state (once per Encounter)" from the Passive "Into the <noparse>Changing Room</noparse>…" does not activate

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: Immediately enter [RougeIshmaelCocoon]
Heal more HP

dataList.name: Soda Pop
dataList.desc:
Sinners who attempt to heal HP on self this turn using Skill or Coin effects gain the following effects next turn:
- Skills deal +10% damage
- Gain [AttackUp] equal to (sum of HP healed during the turn (including excess healing) / 10) (max 6; rounded down)

If there are other Identities on the field that are in the same faction as the units that activated the above effect, they gain half of the [AttackUp] the above units gained (min 1, max 3 per turn; rounded down)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: Deal more damage and gain [AttackUp]

dataList.name: Maison du Noir Slacks
dataList.desc:
When allies that have 2+ [Charge] Potency trigger [VibrationExplosion], apply the following effects:
- Deal ([Charge] Potency on self x [Charge] Count) Envy Damage (2 times per skill, max 100 damage per tick)
- Every 2 times the above effect deals Envy Damage, inflict 3 [Binding] next turn on target

Every time an ally triggers [VibrationExplosion] using a Skill, gain ([Charge] Potency on self / 3) [AttackUp] next turn (max 5 per turn; rounded down)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: Deal Envy Damage and inflict [Binding]
Gain [AttackUp]

dataList.name: Le Noir Mary Janes
dataList.desc:
Combat Start: On Hit from an Identity that has the highest Shield, deal (current Shield / 2) Sloth Damage (2 times per Skill, max 100 damage per tick; rounded down)
- If 2+ Identities have the same Shield HP, applies to the Identity with the earlier Deployment Order

If the affected Identity is a [PersonalityCharge], deal Sloth Damage equal to current Shield instead (3 times per skill, max 100 per tick; rounded down)

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: Deal Sloth Damage based on Shield

simpleDesc.simpleDesc: Inflict [SewingKingMark]; deal fixed damage on death

dataList.name: Cartilage
dataList.desc:
Skills that consume [Charge] Count or Unique [Charge] deal +([Charge] Potency on self x 2)% damage (max 10%)

Turn End: Units that consumed [Charge] Count or Unique [Charge] this turn gain 1 [Agility] next turn

If a unit's Speed is faster than the target's, Clash Power +1
- If the said unit is a "Sisyphe" Identity, gain Final Power +1 instead

- Combat End: If the affected Identity is a "Sisyphe" Identity, gain 1 [ResultEnhancement] next turn
